items: Chick-fil-A grows by earning more from each restaurant, so make sales per unit a core KPI alongside how many locations you open.
Its drive-thru focuses on throughput, using dual lanes, outside order-takers and a kitchen built for the rush, so ask how many more orders per hour you could serve without adding staff.
A tight, focused menu speeds up prep, cuts waste and reduces labor per order, so watch whether frequent new items are hurting your operations.
Its app combines mobile ordering, rewards and direct communication, and investing in your own first-party loyalty program can bring guests back more reliably than discounts.
Owner-operators who run a single store build strong community ties and close attention to the guest experience at every location.
